280532557ce00cf81a6cde850fd4ba96.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Nampho Shipyard
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the Nampho Shipyard on November 2.
He was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the C.C., WPK.
He was greeted at the shipyard by leading officials of the Shipbuilding Institute and the shipyard.

The Nampho Shipyard is pushing ahead with the project to modernize its overall production lines and also making progress in the building of a new warship, under the tasks of the warship building sector set forth by the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK and the decision made at the First Enlarged Meeting of the WPK Central Military Commission.
Comrade Kim Jong Un learned in detail about the master plan for updating the shipyard and then about the economic organization for the modernization project and the progress in the project.

He referred once again to the opinion of the WPK Central Committee on the historical need to accelerate the expansion of capacity of the Nampho Shipyard and other major shipyards and their technical upgrading.

The strategy for developing the shipbuilding industry set forth by the Party Congress clearly indicates the specific orientation for expanding the capacity of the existing shipyards and increasing the operation rate of all the shipyards, he said, adding that the implementation of this strategy means the updating of major infrastructure of the state which is of key importance in rapidly developing the country's marine industry for the future economic prospect, defending the security of the sea border and maritime sovereignty and exercising the strategic deterrent.

In particular, it is vital and important requirement of the times to rapidly bolster up the surface and underwater combat power for defending the national sovereignty in the sea under various threats, he said. Stating that the necessity to completely upgrade the combat power of the navy at present is attributable to the circumstances which compels us to contain the nuclear blackmail and threat of the enemies in the region, the source of creating the new geopolitical situation and substantially and gravely affecting the national security, he said that the timely adopted development plan in the shipbuilding industrial sector is a responsible option in view of the national prosperity and security and an expression of action for the just will to ensure the prosperity and development of the country and defend its peace.

Saying that the advanced and hi-tech shipbuilding base is essential for building a powerful naval force which no one can provoke, Comrade Kim Jong Un stressed the need for the shipyard to set the standard goal of modernization in terms of raising the higher efficiency in the aspects of quality and productivity and in the direction of saving manpower and establish an intelligent integrated production system which comprehensively controls the whole course of shipbuilding, thus opening a new path and creating model experience in the development of the shipbuilding industry.

He set forth the important principle and tasks for modernizing the shipyard, including the issues of highly automating all the elements of production process, constructing one more ground dock to create the capacity for building and repairing ships at the same time, and correcting the irrational matters in the layout of the shipyard's buildings.
He also stressed the need to pay due attention to employing more promising talented persons in the field of designing and building the ships and increasing the number of those engaged in that field.

Saying that our inviolable maritime sovereignty is guaranteed only by the most responsible efforts and practical and advanced defence technology, he affirmed that if all shipyards of the country are modernized as planned by the Party Central Committee, a great revolution will take place in the development of the shipbuilding industry.
That day, Comrade Kim Jong Un went round the warship building site of the Nampho Shipyard.

He said that the building of latest-type warships in succession is a proof of the actual development of our shipbuilding sector, which increases confidence in the prosperity and development of our shipbuilding industry. He noted that if the talented shipbuilding group is combined with excellent advanced technology at once, our country will take a seat on the front row of the world's most powerful shipbuilding industry.
He expressed great satisfaction, looking at a warship under construction which is incomparably huge and browbeating than the destroyer built last year.

The new warship, designed to carry out its complex operational mission in consideration of the present-day warfare, the world trend of development and the specific situation of our country on the basis of comprehensive analysis of the development history of warships which many countries have updated through many repeated research in the historical changes, is being built into a combat system with the one and only capabilities from the designing stage, he said, referring to the important military significance of an aggregate of the huge combat power.

Comrade Kim Jong Un stressed that the necessity to possess the most developed and powerful warship is proved without words by the recent geopolitical environment and hostile acts of the enemies, and therefore, the urgency is being highlighted than ever before and it is because we should defend the country, ensure sovereignty and deter all threats.

He asked the workers of the Nampho Shipyard and all the builders involved in the modernization of the shipyard to respond to the sacred mission entrusted by the revolution with their consistent devotion and responsible efforts for the security and prosperity of the country.

His field guidance to the Nampho Shipyard serves as a warm encouragement to the development and might of our shipbuilding industry, which is playing a key role in attaining the strategic target for developing the national industry and bolstering up the national defence capabilities through radical leap forward and revolutionary acceleration, and a significant occasion in adding confidence and courage to its sky-high spirit and advance. -0-

84c7cd4e912ccd4915c8b2f6b827eb7c.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Tenth Congress of UAWK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had a photo session with the participants in the Tenth Congress of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea on November 9.

All the participants paid high tribute to Comrade Kim Jong Un as a token of their deep thanks to him who ushered in a great new era of socialist rural development and has bestowed profound trust and honour upon the agricultural workers' union so that it can play the role of an advance unit, the vanguard in it.
Comrade Kim Jong Un congratulated the chairman and the vice-chairmen of the Tenth Central Committee of the UAWK elected at the congress.

He extended warm encouragement to the participants who fully demonstrated the firm faith of the agricultural workers, determined to always remain loyal to the ideology and leadership of the Party, through the congress, which was held in the first year for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Party, the significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the UAWK, and glorified the congress as an occasion for making new leaps forward in the gigantic transformation of all rural villages across the country.

Saying that the patriotic farm workers of the country, who single-mindedly upheld the intention of the Party and shared their destiny with the country, have firmly propelled the advance of the socialist cause with increased grain production for the past five years, too, he highly appreciated the great efforts and exploits of the agricultural workers and UAWK members who dedicate their pure civic conscience and sweat to every field of socialist farms.

Stressing that the Party Central Committee remains unshakable in its plan and decision to make the faithful agricultural workers enjoy the benefits of ideal society, highly civilized and prosperous, earlier than anyone else as they are the direct embodiments and implementers of the immutable revolutionary principle that rice just means socialism and communism, he underlined the need for the UAWK to play the role of the ideological agitator and vanguard that accelerates the rural development, mindful of the original heavy duty it has assumed in the historic course of opening up a new stage in the state development.

Noting that it is the primary duty of the UAWK in the period of the new long-term plan to further accelerate the drive for revolutionizing the rural areas in terms of ideology, technology and culture, he urged the UAWK to thoroughly ensure the implementation of the Party policy by promoting its qualitative development and constantly enhancing its activity and working efficiency, as required by the current reality witnessing unprecedented changes in socialist rural construction.

He had a photo taken with the participants, expressing expectation and belief that they would successfully carry out their honourable mission and duty for the times and the revolution by regarding the programme for rural revolution in the new era as signpost for innovation and progress and turning all the organizations of the union into strong ones for implementing the Party's plan.

The participants in the congress made a firm pledge to tangibly contribute to the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism by dedicating their redoubled effort and great executive faculty to bringing about a drastic turn in the union's work. -0-

86248138bcbdc42fce2d1a575777bfc0.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Newly-built Modern Residential Quarters in Thongchon County of Kangwon Province
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 12 (KCNA) -- A thousand and tens of new modern houses have appeared in the township and several ris of Thongchon County situated on the east coast, where the construction of a large-scale naval base is going on, visualizing the noble view on people of the Workers' Party of Korea which gives top priority to the interests and convenience of the people in administrating all the state affairs. They are near to an auspicious event for moving into new houses.

Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the completed new modern residential quarters in Thongchon County of Kangwon Province on Nov. 11.
He was greeted on the spot by senior officials of the construction headquarters and commanding officials of all the provincial shock brigades of Party members involved in the construction.
Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction, enjoying a bird's-eye view of the modern residential quarters in the township of Thongchon County wonderfully built in a little over two months.

He appreciated that the appearance of new residential quarters in good harmony with different types of low- and multi-story dwelling houses shows another valuable achievement made at a time when the regional construction is being expanded and intensified across the country.

Noting that the internal structure of houses was regarded as of great importance to further promote the convenience of residents and their external shapes are diverse and peculiar, he said that the requirement of the Party's regional construction policy on maintaining the principle of modernity, culture, innovation and diversity in regional construction has been correctly met.

In order to make the implementation of our Party's policy on regional development and the rural housing construction steadily lead to successful outcome amid the active support of all the people across the country, it is an important requirement for the construction sector to consider the work for implementing the Party's plan and decisions in a scientific and economic way and correctly carry them out, he said, adding: The figure of growth symbolic of regional change is important for us, but deeper attention should be paid to the material and cultural well-being and the level of civilization of the regional people being more quantitatively improved and efflorescing every year.

The work to eliminate the differences between town and countryside and definitely ensure the environment for simultaneous, multiple and balanced development in the country is put into practice and proved through construction, the main sphere of our revolution, Comrade Kim Jong Un said, adding that the attitude toward our Party's construction policy on attaching importance to the three elements of design, construction work and building materials is just a touchstone for estimating the viewpoint on the future of the revolution.

He pointed out that the importance of the position and role of the construction sector in helping the people feel the changing times and new thriving in practice life is being stressed whenever an opportunity presents itself, but various evils still appear in regional construction.

Noting that despite several warnings that the design and construction control sectors failed to guarantee the implementation of the Party's construction policy with innovative insight and responsible practice in particular, they have not yet been awakened and have failed to eradicate unscientific formalism and unrealistic stylish manner in regional construction including the rural housing construction, and so on, he analyzed the causes in various aspects.

Saying that the Party's standpoint that strengthening the local areas is the one of our national power and socialism is firm and the construction project for Regional Development 20x10 Policy and the construction of modern houses according to the programme for the rural revolution are important revolutionary tasks to be carried out unconditionally and without fail, he clarified again the important principles and ways to be adhered to in the regional construction.

Comrade Kim Jong Un highly appreciated that the provincial shock brigades of Party members involved in the construction of new modern residential quarters in Thongchon County set a good example in regional construction, deeply conscious that giving precedence to the construction of dwelling houses for the evacuees prior to the major policy construction project is a political undertaking to maintain the consistent principle of our Party giving top priority to the interests and convenience of the people. He expressed satisfaction over the fact that thanks to the vanguard and revolutionary struggle of the shock brigades of Party members, our Party could push ahead with the implementation of the huge military policy for building a naval base.
That day, Comrade Kim Jong Un met members of the provincial shock brigades of Party members and warmly encouraged them.

Expressing expectation and belief that the members of the shock brigades of Party members possessed of ardent loyalty and enthusiasm would glorify their honor with great labor feats as befitting absolute defenders and implementers of the Party's policies, he had a photo session with them. -0-

d087f7540d3b586bb87a65b6b8c2319a.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Major Naval Base under Construction
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 12 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Nov. 11 gave field guidance at the construction of major naval base on the east coast, which is being accelerated under the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress and the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Party Central Committee.
He was accompanied by Marshal Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Military Commission, leading officials of the WPK Central Committee and officials in the field of design.
Comrade Kim Jong Un was told about the progress of the project by commanding officers on the spot.

He referred to the orientation and prospect for building the centre of the Korean-style naval command, the center of naval culture and the center of naval combat capability as early as possible and building up the infrastructure of the naval base.

Saying that the prospect of the construction of the modern naval city is optimistic as there are the firm strategic plan of our Party and the high enthusiasm of the entire Party, the whole army and all the people who are enthusiastically responding to it, he clarified the strategic importance of the construction of the naval base.

He said that as the construction of the modern naval base is a crucial core undertaking directly related to the security of our state and the defence of its maritime sovereignty from A to Z, it should be completed without fail at the qualitative level required by the Party Central Committee within the period set by the Party Central Committee.

Comrade Kim Jong Un set forth guidelines on the arrangement of strategic elements for thoroughly realizing the modernization, multi-functionalization and fortification of the base and assigned important measures for the full-scale progress of the construction of the naval port including the powerful reinforcement of the commanding force of the project and the increase of the building force. -0-
